To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) elementary teachers often shy away from raising controversial issues, (2) teachers can raise controversial issues with students in a way that encourages critical thinking, and (3) students can engage with provocative issues in meaningful ways.
